metadata.description: Feature adoption failure investigation focusing on collaboration tool underutilization

turns.content: Our collaboration feature has only 15% adoption rate. Can you investigate why accounts aren't using it?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should propose analyzing feature adoption patterns

turns.content: Show me feature adoption rates by account tier.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate adoption rate by plan tier

turns.content: For feature adoption, define 'adopted' as accounts that have used the feature at least 3 times.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use 3+ uses threshold for adoption

turns.content: Which user roles are using the collaboration feature most?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze adoption by user role

turns.content: When analyzing feature events, always use event.created_at timestamp.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should confirm and use created_at

turns.content: Exclude trial accounts from this analysis.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter out trial plan tier

turns.content: Remember the adoption rate by tier? Can you show that with industry breakdown?

annotations.anaphoricPhrase: Remember the adoption rate by tier?
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recreate tier adoption with industry dimension

turns.content: What's the correlation between collaboration adoption and account retention?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze retention vs adoption correlation

turns.content: What was the adoption threshold we established?
Apply the same adoption criteria to find accounts at risk of non-adoption.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use 3+ uses threshold to identify at-risk

turns.content: What filters are we currently applying?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list: adopted >= 3 uses, use created_at, exclude trial

turns.content: Earlier we looked at user roles. Which roles never use collaboration?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall role analysis and identify non-using roles

turns.content: Apply all our filters and show me a final adoption summary.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply: adopted >= 3 uses, created_at, exclude trial

turns.content: Show me the top 5 actions to improve adoption.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should provide adoption improvement recommendations

turns.content: Thank you. We've identified that collaboration adoption is hindered by: lack of awareness in Healthcare/Legal industries, drop-off at first-use for new accounts, and correlation with smaller team sizes. Adopters have significantly better retention.

persistedCorrections.correctionText: Adopted = used feature at least 3 times
persistedCorrections.description: Use 3+ uses threshold for adoption definition
Always use created_at for event timing

anaphoricReferences.phrase: Remember the adoption rate by tier?
